frozen: 2026-11-02, owner approval of the water delivery planner (docs/OWNER_APPROVALS_2026_11_02_EN.md part B); change only as a new version
label: Simulation: synthetic network on the real main canal; not a water order

horizons.note: operational: per outlet and 12-h slot; tactical: per outlet and dekad; season: per secondary and dekad, as a range

turn.basis: owner 2026-11-02: 500-1,000 m3 per hectare per irrigation event, counted as water entering the field; nothing after the field inlet is modelled (no field-application loss)

losses_sensitivity.basis: owner 2026-11-02, approved as proposed; secondary includes tertiary canals

activity.basis: owner 2026-11-02 (B4): water only for farm land active on the planning date, judged from satellite views usable by that date; uncertain land shown separately; before growth shows, last season's state with a label
activity.signal: the cultivation-change v2 green definition: a clear view (NDVI valid fraction >= 0.8, NDVI in [-1, 1], cloud-leak dates masked) with NDVI >= 0.5 and vegetation fraction >= 0.5

states.active: two or more green views this season up to the planning date
states.expected: no green view yet, before the type's green-up date, and active last season (label: last season's state)
states.idle_so_far: no green view this season and either past the green-up date with enough clear views, or idle last season
states.unclear: anything else (one green view, too few clear views); shown separately, no water
states.no_farm_water: land class without canal water need (no crop, not farmland, greenhouse, not classifiable)

realism.basis: irrigation canal operations expert review 2026-11-02, docs/PLANNER_REALISM_FIXES_PROPOSAL_2026_11_02_EN.md; owner: apply fixes 1-4 with the proposed values

operating_logic_v2.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02 (docs/CANAL_LOGIC_DESIGN_REFERENCE_2026_11_02_EN.md, sections A-G), owner-approved; ramp placement F: the engineer's version
operating_logic_v2.supersedes: where these rules differ, they replace the older ones without changing their values: below 50 % of the head reach's design flow, reach blocks with check gates are on by default (B; realism.min_draw_share_of_reach_design applies only when check gates are switched off); realism.turn_end_drain_loss_share now applies to every close, not only the turn end (C); the fixed 0.7 m/s of canal_ops_rotation_v1 speed_m_per_s is replaced by the flow-dependent velocity (G1); outlet streams are 20-50 l/s instead of the outlet capacity (G2); 'not taken' is replaced by the tail escape (A)

order: next outlet in the same secondary
night.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (A): 60-70 % of due outlets take a night turn (fixed share 0.65 chosen by a stable hash of the outlet name, no randomness); tail outlets and turns over 8 h always; canal extra fill 5 % of the main canal volume is carried to the morning

escape.capacity_basis: owner 2026-11-03 'ok set 2', after the irrigation engineer (2.3 m3/s, about half the stage II inlet 4.53 m3/s) and the canal operator (1.8 m3/s, silted old escapes); simulation assumption, unverified; main-canal tail escape only, secondary escapes counted separately; peak above capacity = error, above 80 % = warning; escaped volume above 12.5 % of released = waste warning (safe but wasteful)
escape.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (A, G4): target <= 5 % of each 12-h block; the capacity is a simulation assumption; above the target the plan is flagged, above the capacity it is a planning error: 'supply exceeds what can be routed: reduce the head'

reach_blocks.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (B): check gates hold the level; below 50 % of the head reach's design flow the canal runs in reach blocks of whole 12-h slots, tail reach first, one switch per change time; offtakes in the checked reach draw at >= 25 % of that reach's own design flow

close_reopen.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (C): every close loses 50 % of the water stored in the secondary at the running flow; every reopen refills the full prism, less 30 % if dry under 12 h; a gap under 6 h keeps a 20 l/s holding flow instead of closing

ramp.placement: engineer: ramps inside the window, plateau raised so released = confirmed; cap-bound -> plateau extended, reported as a deviation
ramp.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (D, F): the head ramps up from the window start (07:00); a ramp-down that would fall in 23:00-05:00 at the head starts at 05:00 instead

steps: hard floors: never zero twice, protected minimum
score S = 40 D + 25 C + 20 T + 15 R
concentrate full turns below 60 % of due demand
order.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (E); tolerance days within the reference's ranges (vegetables 5-7, vineyards and old orchards 10-14, cereals and alfalfa wait); section turn follows the approved rotation order (canal_ops_rotation_v1 stage2_window)

velocity.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (G1): v = 0.7 (Q / Q design)^0.4, about 0.5 m/s at 40 % of design

streams.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (G2): whole 20 l/s hand streams in proportion to area and turn, 20-50 l/s per outlet, at least 2 streams at earthen gates; one turn depth per user

stress_test.basis: expert design reference 2026-11-02, owner-approved (G6): a ditch rider 2 h late at 19:00; reaches served only by night turns

freeze.rule: applies to changes during a window, not to a new plan made before it starts (owner 2026-11-02)
